bullets.text: A man died in Uthukottai after a roadside banner fell on his bike, and the office should monitor the injured wife's treatment.
A 25-year-old man named Murugan died after crashing his two-wheeler into a truck on the Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Radial Road, and the office should review road safety.
Avadi city police arrested 61 people during a special drive against criminals, and the office should track local law and enforcement updates.
The Tamil Nadu Textbook and Educational Services Corporation Chairman inspected Tiruttani schools and advised keeping campuses clean, so the office should watch school sanitation efforts.

stories.title: 25-year-old killed as two-wheeler crashes into truck
takeaways: A 25-year-old man named Murugan died after crashing his two-wheeler into a truck on Sunday.

stories.title: 61 arrested in Avadi police crackdown
takeaways: Avadi City Police arrested 61 individuals, including 12 history-sheeters, during a special anti-rowdy drive.
The crackdown conducted between November 13 and 15 aims to improve law and order in the commissionerate.
